description: This Java source file defines a class FaultyMessageMapper that implements the MessageMapper interface. The class is designed to always throw exceptions during mapping operations, likely for testing error handling. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging' package and uses various connectivity and mapping classes from the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: FaultyMessageMapper
classes.description: An implementation of MessageMapper that throws exceptions to simulate failure during message mapping for testing purposes.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with a given mapping configuration; implementation is empty, indicating no configuration needed.

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage message)
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects; always throws an IllegalStateException indicating inbound mapping failure.

methods.name: map (Adaptable adaptable)
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable object to a list of ExternalMessage objects; always throws an IllegalStateException indicating outbound mapping failure.
